scope: Exact byte reuse of an already-qualified offline checker, tests, evaluation plan and rubric. No new test, production verifier, session/export, model, provider, app, UI, resource, process or cleanup execution.

reusedQualification.limits: Pure helper and temporary synthetic structural-bundle tests. No production CLI, numerical simulation, real export inspection, app, provider, UI or model calls. Historical checker and runtime source unchanged.

copiedRubricAndEvaluationBasis.scope: All four copied source byte identities match their original frozen hashes. The separately documented prior review-file amendment is not copied into this source set.

relativePathReview.checker: CLI input/output/protocol/executable paths remain explicit absolute arguments; no embedded episode or owned endpoint fallback.
relativePathReview.test: Python import resolves copied checker beside the test file; protocol tests read neighboring run-plan.json. No test run occurred here.
relativePathReview.documentation: EVALUATION local checker-tests-01.json resolves this reuse receipt, which links the historical executed qualification; shared/root links retain the same directory depth.
relativePathReview.protocolQualification: The new protocol/admission must be separately frozen and reviewed. Reused tests do not qualify changed configuration or prove a new model episode completed.
